description: Rotary Club of Bombay Kandivli successfully delivered 1,150 BioR Flex 01 BS Leucocyte Filters, valued at ₹10.35 lakh, to Bai Jerbai Wadia Hospital for Children, Mumbai, on 19 October 2026 and The formal handover took place at Wadia Children’s Hospital in the presence of PDG Rtn Rajendra Agarwal, Mr Jagga Raju, CSR Head, IPCA Laboratories, and RCBK members on 28th October. Our heartfelt gratitude to IPCA Laboratories, our CSR donor, and to all members and partners whose commitment made this meaningful contribution possible.
